evidence_policy.fabrication_rule: If a learner-facing field lacks an exact authorized fact binding, leave it unresolved. Never convert a surface gloss, dictionary gloss, root relation, page context, or candidate fact into contextual meaning or translation.
evidence_policy.statement: The bridge consumes and hash-verifies the exact occurrence-bound Naḥw schema, sample and metadata, Sarf schema, sample and metadata, and canonical surface authority. It preserves their states and dependencies and emits source-clean candidate projection inputs whose learner statements are mechanically traceable to fact ids and spans.

guards: The METHOD transfers: exact fact-to-claim binding, contextual translation safety, public cleanliness, and dependency invalidation may be reused; no occurrence conclusion transfers by surface, root, lexeme, or page resemblance.

Before projection, recompute and match the exact SHA-256 values for the Naḥw schema, facts.sample.jsonl and facts.sample.meta.json and the Sarf schema, projection-parity.sample.json and projection-parity.sample.meta.json. Then verify both upstream metadata contracts bind the current canonical index and manifest. Packet ordering alone is insufficient.
This packet builds candidate projection inputs only; TP-PVN-A4-CANONICAL-REGEN-W1 owns website-compatible payload generation.
A dictionary or surface gloss never becomes an occurrence translation without authorized contextual facts.
Every learner statement carries exact fact, field, occurrence, and span bindings; unresolved rivals remain visible.
Candidate and unresolved states never become certified or learner-deployed states.

Public cleanliness is a mutation-tested gate in both the Sarf hover compiler and this bridge. Source prose, external source labels, reviewer-private artifacts, private paths, credential markers and machine topology fail closed.

Start only from a clean isolated worktree. Freeze HEAD before edits under out/nahw-public-projection-w1/start-sha.txt, retain that immutable start SHA, and compare both tracked and non-ignored untracked paths against the exact six-file repository allowlist. Git diff --check is a separate gate.

No predecessor A1 or A2 file, A3 file, fact ledger implementation, projector implementation, canonical graph, existing website payload, renderer, tools/check_regressions.py, docs/golden-commands.md, or live surface is writable. Shared harness and golden-command registration is reserved for TP-PVN-REANCHOR-HARNESS-INTEGRATION-W1.
